bio: I'm a Product Manager who believes great products come from deeply understanding people and their problems. I combine analytical thinking with creative problem-solving to build things that matter.

Currently pursuing my MBA at IIM Ahmedabad, I bring a builder's mindset to everything I do. I love the intersection of technology, design, and business strategy — and I'm most energized when turning ambiguous problems into clear, elegant solutions.
When I'm not building products, you'll find me writing about product management, exploring new tools, or diving into open-source projects.
